nodes.name: ClubSpark Package Import Queue Export Webhook

parameters.jsCode:
const sqlLiteral = (value) => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
};
const request = $input.first()?.json ?? {};
const requestedValues = request.item_ids.map((id) => `(${Number(id)})`).join(',\n    ');
const sql = `
WITH requested_ids(item_id) AS (
  VALUES
    ${requestedValues}
),
venue_settings AS (
  SELECT max(gs.value) AS venue_slug
  FROM public.global_settings gs
  WHERE gs.key = 'clubspark_venue_slug'
),
all_selected AS (
  SELECT
    q.id,
    q.batch_id,
    q.raw_member_id,
    q.member,
    q.source_membership,
    q.target_membership,
    q.status,
    q.notes,
    q.created_at,
    q.exported_at,
    q.imported_at,
    q.export_file_name,
    b.status AS batch_status,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(rm."Venue ID"), ''), NULLIF(trim(member_contact."Unique ID"), '')) AS member_unique_id,
    member_contact_match.resolve_rule AS member_contact_resolve_rule,
    rm."First name" AS member_first_name,
    rm."Last name" AS member_last_name,
    rm."Email address" AS member_email,
    rm."Start Date" AS member_start_date,
    rm."Expiry Date" AS member_expiry_date,
    rm."Cost" AS member_cost,
    rm."Paid" AS member_paid,
    rm."Gift aid" AS member_gift_aid,
    rm."Gender" AS member_gender,
    rm."Date of birth" AS member_birth_date,
    rm."Phone number" AS member_home_number,
    rm."Work number" AS member_work_number,
    rm."Mobile number" AS member_mobile_number,
    rm."Emergency phone number" AS member_emergency_phone_number,
    rm."Postcode" AS member_postcode,
    rm."Address 1" AS member_address_1,
    rm."Address 2" AS member_address_2,
    rm."Address 3" AS member_address_3,
    rm."Town" AS member_town,
    rm."County" AS member_county,
    rm."Country" AS member_country,
    rm."Occupation" AS member_occupation,
    rm."British Tennis Number" AS british_tennis_number,
    rm."Date joined venue" AS member_date_joined_venue,
    rm."Medical history" AS member_medical_history,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(rm."Contact source"), ''), NULLIF(trim(rm."Venue source"), ''), NULLIF(trim(rm." Venue source"), '')) AS member_source,
    rm."Key pin number" AS member_key_pin_number,
    rm."Tags provided" AS member_tags_provided,
    target_map.clubspark_package_id,
    CASE
      WHEN target_map.clubspark_package_id IS NULL OR venue_settings.venue_slug IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE format(
        'https://clubspark.lta.org.uk/%s/Admin/Membership/Import?packageID=%s',
        venue_settings.venue_slug,
        target_map.clubspark_package_id::text
      )
    END AS clubspark_import_url
  FROM requested_ids r
  LEFT JOIN public.signup_batch_clubspark_import_items q
    ON q.id = r.item_id
  LEFT JOIN public.signup_batches b
    ON b.id = q.batch_id
  LEFT JOIN public.raw_members rm
    ON rm.id = q.raw_member_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL resolve_best_contact_row(
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(q.member), ''), NULLIF(trim(concat_ws(' ', rm."First name", rm."Last name")), '')),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(q.email_address), ''), NULLIF(trim(rm."Email address"), '')),
    NULLIF(trim(rm."Last name"), ''),
    false
  ) member_contact_match(contact_id, payer_name, first_name, last_name, email_address, phone_number, mobile_number, address_1, address_2, address_3, town, county, postcode, venue_id, member_status, resolve_rule, candidate_count)
    ON q.id IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN public.raw_contacts member_contact
    ON member_contact.id = member_contact_match.contact_id
  LEFT JOIN public.clubspark_membership_import_targets target_map
    ON target_map.target_membership = q.target_membership
  CROSS JOIN venue_settings
),
selected AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM all_selected
  WHERE id IS NOT NULL
),
validation AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_ids) = 0 THEN 'Select at least one queued package-import row.'
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selected) <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_ids) THEN 'One or more selected queue rows could not be found.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE batch_id <> ${Number(request.batch_id)}) THEN 'Selected rows must all belong to the requested batch.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE target_membership <> ${sqlLiteral(request.target_membership)}) THEN 'Selected rows must all belong to the requested target package.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE batch_status <> 'Processing') THEN 'ClubSpark package exports are only allowed while the batch is Processing.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE status NOT IN ('queued', 'exported')) THEN 'Only queued or previously exported rows can be included in this package export.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE clubspark_package_id IS NULL) THEN 'This target package does not yet have a mapped ClubSpark package ID.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE NULLIF(trim(member_unique_id), '') IS NULL) THEN 'One or more selected members are missing a ClubSpark Contact ID.'
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT clubspark_package_id) FROM selected) <> 1 THEN 'Selected rows must resolve to exactly one ClubSpark package import destination.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error_message
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE public.signup_batch_clubspark_import_items q
  SET status = 'exported',
      exported_at = now(),
      export_file_name = ${sqlLiteral(request.file_name)}
  FROM selected s, validation v
  WHERE v.error_message IS NULL
    AND q.id = s.id
  RETURNING q.id
)
SELECT
  v.error_message,
  s.id,
  s.batch_id,
  s.raw_member_id,
  s.member,
  s.source_membership,
  s.target_membership,
  s.status,
  s.notes,
  s.created_at,
  s.exported_at,
  s.imported_at,
  s.export_file_name,
  s.member_unique_id,
  s.member_contact_resolve_rule,
  s.member_first_name,
  s.member_last_name,
  s.member_email,
  s.member_start_date,
  s.member_expiry_date,
  s.member_cost,
  s.member_paid,
  s.member_gift_aid,
  s.member_gender,
  s.member_birth_date,
  s.member_home_number,
  s.member_work_number,
  s.member_mobile_number,
  s.member_emergency_phone_number,
  s.member_postcode,
  s.member_address_1,
  s.member_address_2,
  s.member_address_3,
  s.member_town,
  s.member_county,
  s.member_country,
  s.member_occupation,
  s.british_tennis_number,
  s.member_date_joined_venue,
  s.member_medical_history,
  s.member_source,
  s.member_key_pin_number,
  s.member_tags_provided,
  s.clubspark_package_id,
  s.clubspark_import_url
FROM validation v
LEFT JOIN selected s
  ON v.error_message IS NULL
ORDER BY s.member, s.id;`;
return [{ json: { ...request, sql } }];
